title: The Last Technical Interview
summary: Steve Yegge's influential essay proposing that AI/LLM-based systems should replace human interviewers for initial technical screening, arguing that traditional whiteboard coding interviews are dehumanizing and inefficient, freeing human engineers to focus on meaningful collaborative work.
problem_solved: It addresses the broken state of technical hiring processes that waste engineers' time and fail to accurately assess real-world job performance.
why_valuable: It offers a provocative vision for transforming hiring by leveraging AI to automate screening while freeing humans for higher-value evaluation.
